title: Chained thought groups: level n is ceil(n/4) sequential passes of up to 4 thoughts, so 8 thoughts is two passes deep
description: Same pretraining and RL as 702; only the thoughts' wiring changes. The incumbent makes a line's n thoughts in one parallel pass from one state (LayerNorm(output at the trigger) + slot embedding j). Here the n thoughts are split into ceil(n / THOUGHT_WIDTH) groups of up to THOUGHT_WIDTH = 4, run one pass after another: group 0's inputs are made from the trigger's output as before, and thought j of group g + 1 is made from the output of thought j of group g (4 parallel chains, Coconut's feedback applied within a line); every thought still attends to everything before it and to its group causally, and the last thought of the last group predicts the line's first token. Levels 1 to 4 are byte-for-byte the incumbent's single pass; levels 5 to 8 are two passes deep. Training (run()) does one extra pass per line for batches drawn at n >= 5 (4 of the 9 counts), sampling (cached()) one extra cached pass per trigger at 8 thoughts; the KV footprint per line is unchanged (still n positions). TRAIN_THOUGHTS 0..8, the plan probe, MTP, and 702's RL (32 samples per target at 8 thoughts, fine-tune at 8 only) are unchanged. check_model.py: training and sampling agree to 3e-6 at n = 0, 1, 3, 8, 16.
hypothesis: In 701 the gain from thoughts was all in the step from 0 to 2 and flat from 2 to 8 (RL sampling after round 1: 30.0, 36.7, 37.0, 36.7% of samples valid), and the incumbent's thoughts cannot do otherwise: the n thoughts of a line are computed in one pass from the same state and differ only by slot embedding and by causal attention among themselves, so more thoughts add width to a per-line decision (which rule, which earlier lines) that needs little width. Chaining gives each extra group another full pass of the six blocks over the previous group's outputs: at 8 thoughts the chain is 12 block applications deep where at 2 it is 6. If a line's decision benefits from sequential refinement (first a candidate rule, then checking its premises against earlier lines), the two-pass level should prove more than the one-pass levels, so metric at 8 should rise above 702's 548 even with fewer pretraining steps, and the gap to metric_diag (0 thoughts) should stay as large as 702's. If depth within a line does not matter at this scale, this is a one-pass model that trains slower and the metric drops by the lost steps.
expected_delta: metric 548 - 30 to 548 + 35. Costs: training batches at n >= 5 take one extra pass per line, so the step rate should fall by roughly a fifth (about 1,250 to 1,400 steps against 702's 1,530 to 1,650; bench_pretrain.py measured 4.8 steps/s in steady state, 206 steps in a 60 s run including setup, peak 11.7 GB, against the incumbent's 5.6), worth maybe 10 to 20 dev theorems; sampling at 8 thoughts takes two cached passes per trigger instead of one, so RL rounds run perhaps 10 to 20% longer, but three rounds should still fit (702 finished its third with about 350 s of RL budget to spare) and the eval stays far inside 5,400 s. Gain if the mechanism is real: +20 to +50 at 8 thoughts. Distinctive prediction: metric minus metric_diag at or above 702's 219 (the no-thought path still gets no RL training). Pretraining val loss by thought count (0, 2, 8) was flat for 701 and 702 (0.082 to 0.085 on the <= 6-line val slice) and is not expected to separate here either; the RL sample accuracy in round 1 (702: 4.5%, 701 at 8 thoughts: 9.6% to 12%) is the first real signal.

arch.type: gpt, 6 untied Peri-LN blocks, plus n continuous thought positions after every `;` and `by` in ceil(n/4) chained groups of up to 4 (LayerNorm(output at the trigger, or of the previous group's thought in the same column) + slot embedding, one pass per group)
arch.pos: alibi on 4 heads, none on 4; thoughts share their trigger's position

optimizer.name: muon (polar express) on block matrices and head + adamw on the rest

config.init: orthogonal on block matrices, fork default elsewhere

thoughts.probe: token after the next `:=` or `exact`, read off the last group's last thought, weight 0.3, pretraining and RL
thoughts.groups: ceil(n / 4) sequential passes; chain j of group g+1 is made from output j of group g; levels 1-4 one pass (the incumbent), 5-8 two passes, 9-12 three, 13-16 four

rl.rounds: until another round would not fit in RL_SECS (1.15 x the last round); expected 3 as 702, each round somewhat longer (two cached thought passes per trigger when sampling at 8)
rl.ft_optimizer: adamw, warmup 50 then cosine to lr/10
rl.loss: next-token CE plus the plan probe at weight 0.3, every micro-batch at 8 thoughts

rl.oracle: Lean AND nd_verify accepted samples of the model's own attempts

eval.metric: dev-transfer theorems solved at L_true >= 7 with KNOB at EVAL_LEVEL
